verdicts.reason: A: the blue headline panel and CTA work, though the button sits awkwardly across the panel's bottom edge. The fare list, however, is tiny and unreadable, out of order (London, Vienna, Paris, then legal text, then Rome, Berlin, Madrid), unevenly spread, and Madrid is off its column. B: the centred blue panel covers the left column's prices (the London, Vienna and Paris fares are cut off), the legal line runs into the panel edge, and the fare text is just as microscopic and scattered around the panel, so it has real collisions as well as illegibility.
